review_revisions.decision: Defer generic cycle node and uses_theory edge: shared calendrical period and later inscription do not demonstrate that the mechanism makers used the specific achievement represented by the node. The proposed node combined an inscriptional witness and a later textual description too broadly.
review_revisions.component_reevaluation: Jones describes the calendar dial as part of the particular mechanism. The existing target is the wider Hellenistic gearing capability, not the mechanism as an individual device. A component part_of that capability would conflate a component and a capability. A correctly scoped whole-device record and reason for a component split would be needed; neither is justified by this bounded task. A coeval component is not an earlier prerequisite.
review_revisions.retained: No discovery, event, relationship, or context change; prior proposal remains in Git history. No separate event extension was made because this round prioritizes constituent links and context rather than event detail.
